judgement.summary: This is a seven-leaf analysis memo whose closing synthesis answers its usability question through Rafael's confirmed question–evidence–action working structure. Its greatest weakness is that most 3D transitions organize text rather than explain substantive work relationships, making the long desktop journey feel more elaborate than its evidence requires.
